query:
UPDATE mdm_parties
        SET status = COALESCE($3, status),
            external_id = COALESCE($4, external_id),
            description = COALESCE($5, description),
            attributes_json = COALESCE($6, attributes_json),
            updated_by = $7,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
